features.title: See which version you're running
features.description:
The title bar at the top of the window now shows the HangarScope version after the app name, for example V1.3.0.

Use it to check that an automatic update has been applied.

images.caption: The version in the title bar, top left of the window

features.title: See which container or ship holds an item
features.description:
On the ASSETS screen, items inside a container or ship now show exactly which one under the station in the LOCATION column, with its name and the bay or slot, for example Paladin “Lasers Go Brr” › Cargo; hover the location for the full path.

The SEARCH box also finds items by container or ship name. Names appear after the next asset sync.

images.caption: ASSETS screen, LOCATION column, searching for container
